message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local CSV files or generated synthetically; there is no remote data fetching, so no checksum verification, signed URLs, or authentication is implemented or needed.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, validation against an expected label set, or label-noise detection tools are present anywhere in the code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection routines, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples in the data preparation flow.

No detected model integrity verification: The code accepts a model path via the --model_path argument and loads from it, but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify the integrity of the loaded model file.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation mechanism, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics; the evaluator computes error ratios directly from passed-in tracks and particles without any integrity controls.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape/range validation or schema checks are performed on incoming data before it is passed to the model; inputs are consumed directly from CSV/fake datasets without sanitization.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM pipeline; the model processes numerical tracking/trajectory data, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable.
